# Openperplex

Openperplex API provides powerful, global search capabilities and web content analysis for AI applications.

Category: Other. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/openperplex/.

## Actions

- **Custom Search** (read-only): Perform a custom search with optional filtering and field selection.
- **Get Website Text** (read-only): Retrieve the main text content of a specified website url.
- **Query from URL** (read-only): Query documents from a url.
- **Search Documents** (read-only): Search documents using query parameters.
- **Search Stream** (read-only): Stream search results from openperplex.
- **Custom Search Stream** (read-only): Perform custom streaming search.
- **Get Website Markdown** (read-only): Retrieve the markdown content of a specified website.
- **Get Website Screenshot** (read-only): Capture a screenshot of a website.
